mapper.select: SELECT b.BOARD_ID, b.BOARD_TITLE, b.BOARD_HIT, b.BOARD_DATE, b.MEMBER_ID, m.MEMBER_LOGINID FROM BOARD b JOIN MEMBER m ON b.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY b.BOARD_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD(BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_CONTENT, MEMBER_ID) VALUES(#{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{memberId})
